title: Concept: Framework SQL built from input (djangoraw) — review required
description: In djangoraw, M.objects.raw("SELECT " + c) mixes SQL text with values. ORM and helper layers pass interpolated text straight to the driver. The remedy is bound parameters via parameter lists.
applicability: djangoraw data calls; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Full database compromise when untrusted input reaches the query; HIGH severity.
